The PO totals 2 cleaning services, 2 packs, 6 fresheners. Received in two deliveries: GR-A (10 Oct) and GR-B (23 Oct), each with 1 cleaning, 1 pack, 3 fresheners = 2/2/6 total, i.e. all received.

Earlier invoice MHL26100409 (2026-10-11, same total) likely corresponds to GR-A (the 10 Oct delivery). This invoice MHL26100417 (2026-10-26) matches the second delivery GR-B (23 Oct). Total invoiced across both = 2/2/6, exactly what was received. So this is a separate later delivery, not a resubmission.
